bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
docker image inspect create-videobot:poll-fresh >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 61
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint /bin/sh create-videobot:poll-fresh -c '
test -d /opt/videobot/src || exit 80
test -d /opt/videobot/src/runtime || exit 81
test -f /opt/videobot/src/runtime/main.mjs || exit 82
test -f /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs || exit 83
test -f /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorPollingConsumer.mjs || exit 84
test -f /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs || exit 85
test -d /opt/videobot/node_modules/pg || exit 86
exit 0'
